units.title: Basic of Electrical Engineering a. Explain Electric current and voltage. b. Explain Electrical circuits and elements: Resistor, inductor,
topics: 1. Definition of current and voltage, units of current and voltage, Ohm’s law, symbol and relation.
2. Characteristics of electrical circuit, resistor in series and parallel, inductor, capacitor
3. Kirchoffs’ current and voltage law
4. Active components(Voltage source and current source), Passive components(Resistor, inductor, capacitor.)
5. Sinusoidal Signal, Triangular wave, square wave, sawtooth wave, amplitude, frequency, wave length, time period.

units.title: Diode theory and Rectifiers
topics: 1. Structure of atom, valence electron, conductor, semiconductor, insulator

2. Doping, Intrinsic semiconductor, extrinsic semiconductor, P-type and N-type semiconductor, majority charge carrier, minority charge carrier, P-N junction, Depletion layer, knee voltage, forward bias, reverse bias
3. Special diodes: LED, Photodiode,zener diode, tunnel diode, LASER diode and Power diode
4. Types of Rectifiers: Half Wave, Full Wave Rectifier (bridge and center tapped): circuit operation I/O waveforms for voltage and current
5. Zener diode as a voltage regulator Fundamentals of Electrical and Electronics Course Code: 4300018

units.title: Transistors a. Distinguish the specification of the given type of transistors b. Differentiate the performance of the specified transisto...
topics: 1. Types of transistors: PNP, NPN
2. Working of transistors.

3. Transistor configurations(CE): circuit diagram, input and output characteristics. Different points of characteristics (Cut- off, Active and Saturation), input resistance, output resistance, current gain.
4. Transistor as a switch.

units.title: Electronic Hardware a. Identify ICs b. Explain PCB types and manufacturing c. Introduce Electronic components manufacturing Hierarchy
topics: 1. Definition, construction, types, example.
2. PCB layout, types, single layer, multi layer, manufacturing of PCB
3. SSI, MSI, LSI, VLSI (Introduction to various technology)
4. RTL, DTL, TTL, CMOS, Fan in, Fan out(Building components, No. of gates supported)
5. Twisted pair, Coaxial cable, fibre optic cable, RJ45 connector, BNC.

units.title: Handling Electronic Waste a. Justify the need of understanding electronic waste b. Establish the relationship of sustainability
topics: 1. Concept of electronic waste.
2. Sustainability and electronic waste
3. Methods to handle electronic waste
4. Disposal of electronic waste Note: The UOs need to be formulated at the ‘Application Level’ and above of Revised Bloom’s Taxonomy’ to accelerate the attainment of the COs and the competency.
